extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia users/editors attempting to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for locating an existing Wikipedia article or creating a new one (including account requirements, searches, redirects, and checking deletion logs). Intended to help users determine why a titled page is missing and how to proceed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed status requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page directly because you are not autoconfirmed, consider using the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article via the appropriate Wikipedia process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Larry David Holocaust joke" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Wikipedia's search to find similar or related pages; check for alternative capitalizations and variant spellings that may already host the content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect backlinks to see whether the topic exists under a different name or was referenced elsewhere; linked pages can indicate the correct article location or common redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newly created page propagation / purge advice
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes for propagation or try the purge function to refresh the page; do not assume deletion immediately after creation if timing is recent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants of the title; if the article exists under a different capitalization, create or request a redirect to aid discovery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log and deletion reasons
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log to learn why a page was removed before attempting to recreate it; follow guidance on addressing deletion reasons (notability, sourcing, policy compliance) when preparing a new draft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or request new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article wizard guides new authors through creating a draft that can be reviewed; requesting a new article (e.g., via appropriate noticeboards) is another path if direct creation is restricted.
